artDirection: 现代旅行手册与中国园林版画：米色纸面、青绿瓦顶、赭红梁柱、玉绿色水面、竹与木的暖色。所有图层为可编辑 SVG。

assets.purpose: 四站共享教学示意地图。建筑受江南园林风格启发，不是真实店铺复刻或实地导航。

altText.zh: 园林教学地图，四处建筑由小径、池塘与曲桥相连。
altText.en: An illustrated garden with four learning destinations connected by paths, a pond, and a zigzag bridge.

assets.responsiveUse: The map and destination cards share the same Building renderer. Preserve the central architectural silhouettes when cropping; check 320px and 681–900px separately. Destination list remains the keyboard-accessible alternative.
assets.textPolicy: No baked labels or actionable text; parent UI supplies localized destination names and keyboard-operable controls.

landmarkDistinctions.restaurant: Wide two-storey restaurant, six upstairs windows, large double doorway, two visible dining tables and warm interior.
landmarkDistinctions.candy: Tall narrow shopfront, three continuous display windows with large distinct candy jars and a side display shelf.
landmarkDistinctions.nanxiang: Low wide takeaway kiosk, lifted bamboo awning, fully open serving hatch, basket stacks, steam and collection counter.
landmarkDistinctions.teahouse: Tall open pavilion above water, visible deck supports, balcony railings, tea tables and an attached zigzag landing.

assets.purpose: 原创教学柜台，分层窗格、暖灯、女性店员、木柜台、竹蒸笼、小笼包与包装袋。不是门店实景复刻。

props.label: Localized accessible image description
props.pose: idle | welcome | speaking | listening | thinking | acknowledging | clarifying | checking | packing | packed; default welcome; previous pose values remain valid

altText.zh: 温暖的木柜台后，店员微笑迎接；柜台上摆着小笼包蒸笼与外带纸袋。
altText.en: A welcoming server behind a warm wooden counter with dumpling baskets and a takeaway paper bag.

assets.responsiveUse: Use a dedicated close composition or contain the whole SVG for narrow screens; central server and dumplings remain primary. Required bag and basket actions need separate text controls.
assets.motion: CSS/SVG character gestures are driven only by the pose prop. speaking uses a simple cycling mouth and palm gesture, not phoneme-level lip sync. All animation is disabled by prefers-reduced-motion: reduce and html[data-reduced-motion=true], retaining distinct static poses. packed is always static.
assets.poseLimits: The component never advances order state, plays audio, starts a timer, saves an order, or infers task completion. Parent selects packing only after successful server save, then packed. Restored completed attempts should select packed immediately. Changes in actual recording/playback/processing select corresponding presentation poses.
assets.quantityPolicy: Normal baskets are environment props, not a default saved order. Only packing/packed render the completed-order group, with exactly two separate takeaway boxes and data-servings=2. Parent UI supplies explicit localized two-servings text; illustrations do not assert a real-store dumpling count.

poseDescriptions.speaking: Open palm and simple opening/closing mouth while actual audio plays.
poseDescriptions.listening: Leans toward the user and cups one hand beside the ear.
poseDescriptions.thinking: Hand at the chin, upward glance, slight thoughtful head tilt.
poseDescriptions.clarifying: Raised eyebrow, head tilt and an open palm clarification gesture.
poseDescriptions.checking: Looks down at a visible order slip and points toward it.
poseDescriptions.packing: One 1800ms sequence moves two separate takeaway boxes into the bag area, closes in on the handoff position and offers the bag.
poseDescriptions.packed: Still handoff with two visible stacked serving boxes and one bag; no replay on mount.

assets.purpose: 地图对应的四个独立建筑小图，供地点卡和回顾复用。
assets.textPolicy: Signboard ornament is decorative geometry. Actual place names are rendered by the parent UI.
assets.responsiveUse: All four silhouettes were reviewed side by side without place-name text. Shared with the map; width, height, open-counter layout and water/bridge setting distinguish the four stops.

accessibility: SVGs have role=img and a per-instance title ID created with React useId. Pass label in the active UI language. Images do not provide interactive controls; the parent interface supplies focusable alternatives.
fonts: None in artwork; no font files or embedded typography.

verification.sourceInspection: Original code-native shapes with no external URLs, image/font assets, or baked user-interface text. Per-instance title and paint IDs use React useId.
verification.typecheck: npm run typecheck passed after the revision.
verification.staticRenderReview: All four landmarks, the complete map and all ten scene poses rendered to PNG offline and visually inspected; corrected transform pivots to preserve hand/head alignment across renderers.
verification.integrationReview: Owner agent has visually confirmed desktop map silhouette differentiation. Real-browser state timing, reduced-motion preference and final desktop/mobile screen captures are part of the main integration check.
verification.temporaryReviewArtifacts: /private/tmp/scene-art-r1/{landmarks,map,poses}.png; offline renders are inspection artifacts, not runtime app assets.
